requiredFindings.title: The ACL arm runs after owner, mode, and group
requiredFindings.failureScenario: An omitted-ACL directory is mode 0777, or owned by another account, or the wrong kind. check returns OthersWrite, ForeignOwner, or NotDirectory before the ACL arm. An implementer who moves the ACL arm ahead of owner, mode, and group, to match item 2, publishes acl-unreadable for that directory and changes the code the 18851-case fixture asserts.

requiredFindings.title: The named subject and the lowercased code differ
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Refusal::code for AclUnreadable is ACL_UNREADABLE, so lower case is acl_unreadable. Item 3 also names the subject acl-unreadable, the 468c hyphen spelling. One reading publishes acl_unreadable and the other publishes acl-unreadable, both on CONFIG.CUSTODY_REFUSED. No publisher lowercases Refusal::code.

requiredFindings.title: The Known pin covers the ancestor placeholder
requiredFindings.failureScenario: A crate-wide forbid of AclWrite::Known except from DescriptorAcl::Present covers check_external_ancestor's Known(Vec::new()) placeholder. Changing that placeholder to Unreadable makes check return AclUnreadable before external_ancestor_acl. A present ancestor ACL that today returns Ok is refused, and a present foreign write allow that is AclWrite becomes AclUnreadable.

scope: Law 461 r1: omitted ACL unreadable at check_descriptor_observation, checked against product HEAD d4239a5. No product cargo.
